THE LITTLE SIDE QUEST

Your daily ride.
A different way to see it.

The idea is simple: make the familiar a little more interesting. Here’s the experience we’re building.

1

SPOT IT

That’s your train.
Or is it?

A familiar route. An unusual sign. A tiny detail that makes you look twice.

2

SNAP IT

Keep your eyes open.
And your camera ready.

Take a clear photo of the sign. It’s the starting point for a closer look.

3

DISCOVER IT

Meet the sign.
Build your Dex.

Explore the design behind the bullet and give your next ride something new to chase.

A PEEK AT THE DEX

Some classics.
A few plot twists.

Same number, different personality.
Tap a bullet to see what makes it stand out.

IN THE DETAILS

A green circle, a white 6, and a familiar face on the Lexington Avenue line. Sometimes the everyday ones are the best place to start.

CIRCLE / LOCAL

Illustrative catalog preview. Reference artwork includes historical and proposed designs; the app is in development.

THE NEXT RIDE IS A NEW CHANCE

The city never stops.
Neither does curiosity.

We’re building TrainDex for the ones who take the long way, look out the window, and always notice the sign.
